text:
tess_sales: Quick sync 1 HelioDynamics wants a performance validation for their POC. Goals: sustained 1k qps across us-west1, eu-west1, p50 < 200ms, p99 < 650ms. They also have encryption-at-rest keys in their HSM and need VPC peering plus SSO. Need a runbook + cost table + security note by EOD.

raj_eng: I'll own the load plan. Confirming models: they plan to test with our 7B quantized baseline and a 13B float16 variant. Packaging will change instance type (A10 vs A100).

maya_sre: Note on peering: cross-region peering will likely add 20-80ms RTTs, we'll pin regional endpoints for main tests. For the multi-region failover test we can do a cross-route spike later. Also HSM demo will be "demo keys" unless they provide a customer HSM access window.

maya_sre: I'll prepare network run checks and MTU validation.

raj_eng: Proposed load phases:
- 00:10:00 warmup (50 qps)
- 00:15:00 ramp to 1k qps
- 00:30:00 steady 1k qps (soak)
- 00:10:00 spike window with 30% of requests having 2x token size
- 00:10:00 cooldown

raj_eng: For measurements: p50/p95/p99 latency, tail GPU kernel time, token throughput, kv-cache hit rate, and cost per 1M tokens. We'll instrument with vegeta + custom streaming harness to mimic client behaviour.

lucy_prod: For pricing table, use hosted rates for 7B/13B and a Dedicated uplift: per-GPU monthly + amortized token cost. I'll draft the spreadsheet.

tom_se: Security checklist: SAML SSO, KMS/HSM envelope flow, SOC2 artifact, pen-test summary. I'll start the questionnaire and flag HSM as "requires ops coordination".

tess_sales: Helio sent sample traffic: avg 140 input tokens and 200 output tokens. Burstiness: Poisson-ish with occasional 100-200% bursts for ~45s. They requested encryption key sync guarantee and EU data residency for eu-west1.

raj_eng: Great. For loadgen payload: { "prompt_tokens":140, "max_tokens":200 }. We'll simulate 85% cache hit to reflect their prefix reuse.

maya_sre: We'll run a smoke at 21:00 PDT to verify endpoint setup and streaming. deploybot can you schedule?

deploybot: Scheduled: helio-smoke-2026-03-21-21:00-PDT. Notifying #eng-runtime. :white_check_mark:

raj_eng: After smoke we'll execute full run tomorrow. I'll post the raw vegeta output, plots, and cost calc in this thread.

lucy_prod: Deliverables: 1) one-page customer slide with p50/p95/p99 + recommendation, 2) cost table for hosted vs dedicated, 3) security gaps list.

tom_se: Heads up: SSO setup needs IdP metadata; if Helio can share today we can do a demo during POC. Otherwise note as blocker.

tess_sales: I'll chase Helio for metadata and pen-test summary. Also I'll upload their service account to LastPass and invite engineering.

maya_sre: I'll monitor KMS telemetry during run and collect GPU metrics (util, mem, kernel latency). Also will measure network RTTs and queue lengths.

raj_eng: Success criteria: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 450ms, p99 < 650ms AND sustained 1k qps for 30m. If p99 exceeded by >15% we will try different kernel packing and re-run.

lucy_prod: I'll assemble numbers into a customer-ready slide deck. 

(Helio-CI): Helio: Confirming we'll share SAML metadata EOD and we can provide a pen-test executive summary.

tess_sales: Thanks all, will post updates and attach artifacts. :rocket:
